title: Turn AWS access on from a phone

slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Turn AWS access on from a phone
slides.subtitle: A temporary gate for agents working in a sandbox account.

slides.title: The situation
slides.body: Sometimes I want an agent to run an AWS experiment while I'm away from my laptop. I don't want admin credentials on my phone.

slides.title: The toggle
slides.body: The sandbox points its credential URI at a Lambda. A phone app toggles that Lambda on and off.

slides.title: Short access windows
slides.body: When the toggle is on, the Lambda returns temporary credentials. When it is off, the sandbox asks for credentials and fails.

slides.title: Same mechanism
slides.body: The same credential endpoint now supports workshops, coding agents in a sandbox account, and phone-controlled AWS access.

slides.supportingText: The System I Built for AWS Access Without Keys.
